goal: Prevent node crashes from block validation calls during startup before the genesis block connects
Protects users starting with an empty datadir or running a reindex against assertion aborts
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Suggested waiting for genesis block loading rather than adding null checks (maflcko)
Strong support because it aligns tip waiting with existing mining methods (w0xlt)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it prevents an assertion abort crash during initial startup or reindexing
Avoids a node failure when block checks are invoked before the active chain tip exists
